title: twd CLI --json output
description: The shape of every twd command's --json output (docs/cli-json.md). $defs are named after the command ('deploy', 'tenant ls'); 'dev.event', 'deploy.event', 'logs.record' and 'logs.line' are NDJSON lines; 'error' is the error line on stderr. Objects may gain properties; the required ones and every listed type are stable. cmd/twd TestAgentEval and TestCLIJSONContract check real output against this file.

timings.description: wall times in milliseconds, by phase

code.description: a code from docs/errors.md; act on it, not on message

hint.description: what to do next: the fix lines joined with newlines, a usage line, or where to read about the code

error.description: one line on stderr when a command fails (exit 1, or 2 for an unknown command); stdout is then empty

object.description: one object: a workload node or a Durable Object instance with its own node

parent.description: the object that spawned this one

verified.description: every chain's hashes and host signatures verify

agentPlan.description: what twd agent setup or remove did, or would do

applied.description: false with --dry-run or when nothing needed doing

secret.description: a secret's metadata; no command returns a value

mcp.description: twd mcp --config: how to register twd's MCP server (twd mcp without --config is the MCP stdio protocol itself)

url.description: mgmt's /mcp, for an agent on a tailnet machine

stdio.description: the command an agent runs (the stdio bridge)

tools.description: the tools this caller may call

grant.description: the twd.dev/cap/mcp grant that adds the missing tools

telemetry.description: twd telemetry [show], set and rm: the tenant's OTLP export (header values are never shown; rm prints only tenantID)

status.description: health of mgmt, the host(s), the tenant and deployments

items.description: the host's workloads as twd-hostd reports them (Go field names: TenantID, Workload, DeploymentID, Status, Error, ...)

tenant set.description: the tenant after the update (the /v1 Tenant)

dev.description: twd dev --once (the smoke test); without --once, see dev.event

serves.description: url plus the MCP route for an MCP app

dev.event.description: twd dev --json without --once: one per line on stdout. ready (first, with url, serves, workload, node, as, tags), then reload or error on each change, request (record) for each request the app serves, stopping on Ctrl-C

deploy.description: the result, on stdout; progress is deploy.event lines on stderr

public.description: the public URL and state, if the app has public routes

warnings.description: wrangler config twd ignores, one line per key

deploy.event.description: twd deploy --json: one per line on stderr: start, preflight, build, log (container image builds), placed, status (each change), ready, then public_wait and public with --wait-public. A failure ends with an error line ({"error": ...}) instead

kvKey.description: a Workers KV key as list() returns it

namespace.description: the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)
the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)
the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)
the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)

kv key get.description: the value base64-encoded (without --json, the raw bytes on stdout)

namespace.description: the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)
the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)

kv key list.description: names, expirations and metadata; never values

namespace.description: the KV namespace (its kv_namespaces id, or the binding name)

queueInfo.description: a tenant queue and its counters (ADR-039)

backlog.description: messages kept: in flight and delayed included

oldestAt.description: unix ms of the oldest message

queueMessage.description: a queue message as peeked (body base64)

approvalWait.description: One approval wait of one Workflow instance (docs/approvals.md; mgmt's Approval).

approvals.description: twd approvals: what waits for a decision (with --all, decided ones too).

approve.description: twd approve: the approval as decided, with the approver's verified identity.

notify.description: twd notify [show], set, test and rm: the tenant's notification webhook (only its origin and header names are shown; test adds the delivery outcome; rm prints only tenantID)

logs.line.description: twd logs --json for raw output (--console, --component, or a workload without request records): one per log line on stdout (with -f, until stopped)

host.description: the replica's host (from a linked machine)

logs.record.description: twd logs <workload> --json (the default, without --console): one structured request record per line on stdout (ADR-observability)

doctor.description: printed also when a check fails; then doctor_failed follows on stderr

host add.description: the join key is written to joinFile (0600), never printed

upgrade.description: twd upgrade: on a twd up machine {plan, upgraded, backup?, rolledBack?, health?}; with --fleet or a linked mgmt, the plan (--plan: {from, to, steps, breaking, blockers, warnings}) or the upgrade run {id, to, state, steps}; twd upgrade status|pause|resume|abort print the run ({runs: []} when there is none).

host vmcheck.description: a microVM's report (workload, pid, rssKB, stats, fsbench, keyscan); with --container, Go field names (Workload, Class, Object, PID, RSSKB, KeyScan)

ref.description: pass it to twd docs show
